FN-AJ6VS7Q-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 199
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/19/2024
Senate Bill 199 as introduced would extend the current quarterly assessment on emergency
medical transport (EMT) providers that will expire on July 1, 2024 to July 1, 2025. In fiscal year
2023, after deducting the costs of collection, the EMT providers' assessment generated $6.1
million for the Alabama Medicaid Agency. The Alabama Medicaid Agency estimates $8.2
million will be collected for fiscal year 2024 from these assessments.
